title: Illumination can go past 12 with +1 while the page shows 12 / 12
where: Lightkeeper Circle page, any size; backend vtt/ws/handlers/gm.py around line 375 (carry = illumination - TRACK)
steps: Set Illumination to 12 (pip 12), press '+1 Illumination'. Read the database and the page.
expected: Either the +1 stops at 12, or the page shows that 1 is carried over to the next track.
actual: The circle row holds 13; the heading and ring still read '12 / 12' and the -1 button brings it back to 12. The server carries the excess over after the advance, but nothing on the page says so, and FAQ.md has no line on it.

title: Chapter House: a member's unsaved draft hides another member's newer save
where: Circle formation papers (unsealed table), phone 390x844, CircleCreationPopup.jsx handleLocationBlur
steps: Two members open section III. A types ' plus' after the current text and does not leave the box. B saves a different chapter house. Look at A's box.
expected: A is told the shared box changed, or the draft is marked as replacing B's text.
actual: A keeps the old draft with 'Not saved yet'. Leaving the box overwrites B's save with no word. The 'Shared' i says saving replaces what anyone wrote, so it is documented, but nothing tells A at that moment.

title: Advance the circle log does not say the resources refilled
where: Activity Log after gm_advance_circle
steps: Fill the track to 12 on a table with spent resources and advance the circle.
expected: A log line or the advance line saying resources refill to 1 plus members, since the manual Refill button is gone and the Lightkeeper will look for it.
actual: Only 'The Far Watch has advanced and gained Stamina Training!'. The resources do refill (1/2/0 became 3/3/3).

title: Report line shows only after turning the Lightkeeper's report card
where: Lightkeeper Circle page, report cards, all sizes
steps: A player files a report with a line. Look at the Lightkeeper's card without flipping it.
expected: Per #58 the Lightkeeper reads the line on the report card.
actual: The front shows only the REPORT FILED stamp; the keys and the line are on the back, behind a flip. This matches the card design (nothing says otherwise), but a mark on the front that a line was filed would save a flip.

title: The server takes a new roll while a gilded choice is still waiting
where: Backend roll handler (rolls.py), seen over the socket on main 1bc48a0; the desk blocks it in rollAction
steps: Open a socket for Pontius. Send roll read with 0 drive (gilded pool 2, needs a keep). Without resolving, send roll sway with 1 Cunning.
expected: FAQ line 18: the server holds the dice until a die is kept, so a second roll should be refused or wait.
actual: The second roll returned a roll_result at once and the first choice was dropped. Only the desk stops it (a second tab or device that has not seen the choice could roll over it).

expected: 60.5: the choice stays still.
actual: On a mouse the shimmy stops on hover, but a finger has no hover so the dice keep moving about 3px (laptop reading when not hovered). I did not tap them on a phone to see whether a tap misses.

title: 60.5 keep-a-die choice still and announced once: partly

Dice stop moving on hover (anim none, positions identical over 0.6s) and a click on a die still keeps it. Not hovered they still shimmy about 3px, and a finger has no hover, so on touch they keep moving (not tapped by script).

title: Second tab on the same account: focus after a roll made in the other tab: not checked

title: Leave and rejoin by request in one assignment resets the player's spend count
where: backend vtt/assignment.py release_from_campaign (end_assignment_for zeroes resources_spent_assignment) with vtt/routers/campaigns.py release_member; seam with #41 (backend/engine.py approve_investigator)

expected: The decisions cap circle spends at two per player per assignment, and #41 makes a replacement keep its predecessor's count. A member coming back in the same assignment would keep the count.
actual: Ros is active again with resources_spent_assignment=0 and can spend two more this assignment. Pools are not refilled, so only the per-player cap is bypassed, and it needs the Lightkeeper's approval.

title: A refused sheet edit shows its reason twice as role=alert
where: tablet 820x1180, player's desk: SheetEditor.jsx error line plus InvestigatorDossier.jsx sheetEditError under the sheet
steps: Open Edit sheet, change pronouns. The server sees the investigator as dead (SQL is_dead=true while the dialog is open). Press Save.
expected: One alert, in the reopened dialog that holds the draft.
actual: Two role=alert elements say 'Rux Ollinor is dead: the sheet is a record.', one in the dialog and one under the sheet behind it, so a screen reader announces it twice. The draft itself is kept correctly.

title: #49 after a server restart: a freed investigator rejoins by the normal join flow: partly
head: Ros left, the backend restarted, Ros asked to join and was approved. Ros is active and pools were not raised. Ros's spend count came back as 0 although he had used 2 this assignment (see findings).

expected: Tab B drops the request card, pop-up and the count; the comment at OperationsPanel.jsx:88 says a request 'another tab answered' is handled.
actual: Tab B still shows the NEW JOIN REQUEST pop-up (now with 'Already has an investigator here.') and 'Requests 1', although the roster in B lists the approved investigator and the log line arrived. A reload clears it. Same stale card on control.

title: #21 Back after a reload keeps a sketch in progress; leaving warns while strokes are unsaved: partly

Reload itself still loses the strokes (warned).

The Back case itself did NOT reproduce in headless Chromium on the control: after a reload, start sketch, Back stayed on the desk with the sketch in both builds, with seeded and with real hub-to-desk navigation.

title: After a restart, stale ally cards end without a word: Behind Me vanishes on reconnect, and Use on a Non-Combatant point is refused silently
where: Player desk, phone 390x844 (Dax). frontend/src/store/gameStore.js: the action_rejected handling for resolve_ability_mark on an offer that holds no mark. FAQ.md:120
steps: 1. Cora (or Finn, a Doctor) takes a mark, so Dax gets a Behind Me card (or a Non-Combatant card). 2. Restart the server and let the desk reconnect. 3a. The Behind Me card disappears when the desk reconnects. 3b. The Non-Combatant card stays; pick NER and press Use.
expected: FAQ.md:120 says that after a restart the ally offers are gone "and an answer to one is refused as too late". The player should see that it did not count, as the desk does for Behind Me refusals (interceptRefused in the card's place).
actual: The Behind Me card simply vanishes on reconnect. The Non-Combatant Use gets action_rejected "No Non-Combatant drive point is waiting.", but the card closes with nothing shown and Nerve is unchanged (2), so the player believes the point was recovered. The control does the same; this is not a regression, but the FAQ promises a refusal the player never sees.
related: #59; decisions_fix6 decision 1; WEBSOCKET.md 4.5 ("A refusal of an answer to an offer that holds no mark ... is not shown there")

title: An open desk that reconnects after a restart keeps offering Burn and reroll and Flourish for a roll the server no longer holds
where: Player desk, laptop 1366x768 (Cora). FAQ.md:78; frontend DiceVault/RollModifications
steps: 1. Roll Read to a Failure; the tray offers Burn and reroll and Flourish. 2. Restart the server and do not reload; the desk reconnects. 3. Press Burn and reroll.
expected: FAQ.md:78: "After a server restart the tray starts empty, since the server no longer holds the roll and would refuse a burn on it." A reconnecting desk should drop the offers (or mark the roll settled) once the server has no shown roll for it.
actual: The tray keeps FAILURE with Burn and reroll and the Flourish prompt. Burn gets action_rejected "Burn a resistance after a roll of that action.", which is shown on the slip, and then "Roll settled". To a player who has just made that roll, the wording is confusing. Only a reload empties the tray, which is the only case the FAQ describes. The control's open desk behaves the same over a restart.

title: Post-roll ability Use and Skip buttons are 22px tall on a phone
where: Phone 390x844, the dice drawer's After the roll panel. frontend/src/components/pc/dice/RollModifications.jsx:116-135 (px-3 py-0.5 text-xs, no coarse-pointer min-height)
steps: 1. Cora (Magician, Flourish) rolls Read to a Failure on a phone. 2. Open Dice and log. 3. Measure the Flourish row's USE and SKIP.
expected: DESIGN.md: 44px touch targets. Burn and reroll beside them is 44px on touch in this build.
actual: USE is 50x22 and Skip Flourish is 46x22, the same on the control. This applies to every post-roll prompt (Flourish, Bending Spoons, Learn from My Mistakes and its drive picker).

title: A mark the Lightkeeper deals to a closed desk lands beside a stored held Death Defy mark, and the old offer comes back afterwards
where: Server, vtt/ws/handlers/marks.py take_mark from the GM socket when no desk is open; Lightkeeper's desk, Deal a mark
steps: 1. Iris (Death Defy) takes a Body mark; a Death Defy offer holds it. 2. Close her desk (a restart in between makes no difference). 3. The Lightkeeper deals Iris a Body mark from an enemy. 4. Iris opens her desk.
expected: Either the held mark lands first and the offer closes, as WEBSOCKET.md says a mark taken while an offer holds one does, or the new mark joins the Death Defy offer (it escapes every mark of one harm).
actual: The dealt mark lands at once (Body 1 of 3, "Their desk is closed, so it landed without a soak or Death Defy"), held_mark is kept, and when Iris opens her desk she gets the Death Defy offer for the first mark, which can then escape a mark after another of the same harm has landed. Seen on main with and without a restart; the control lands the dealt mark the same way (its held mark is in memory). Not a regression; for Robert to rule on.

title: A dead investigator can still file and amend an assignment report
where: Player Circle page, tablet 820x1180; backend/vtt/ws/access.py DEAD_REFUSED (submit_assignment_report missing) and vtt/ws/handlers/circle.py handle_submit_assignment_report (checks status active only; a dead investigator stays active until replaced)
steps: Seal a table with reports open. Kill an investigator with a fourth scar. On the dead player's desk open Circle, tick a key and press Send report. Or send submit_assignment_report with replace:true on the dead desk's socket.
expected: Refused like the dead's other actions (409 'Iris Vane is dead: the sheet is a record.'), and the form hidden or off on the dead desk. The task says the dead cannot file a report, and the count already leaves the dead out.
actual: Report stored, 'Iris Vane filed an assignment report.' and later 'amended their assignment report.' go to every desk. The Lightkeeper's Circle page shows a 'Report filed' card for Iris next to 'Not filed: Bram Holt, Cora Lune' and '0 of 2 filed'. The report stays in the circle's reports even after Iris is replaced.

title: A death lowers the resource maximum without telling any desk, and leaves each pool above it
where: All desks' circle resources; backend/vtt/ws/handlers/character.py handle_apply_scar (no circle_update, no lower_resources_to_pool); vtt/circle_queries.py resource_pool counts living members only
steps: Sealed circle of 3 with Stitch 4, Refresh 4, Train 3 (max 4). Kill one member with a fourth scar. Look at the Lightkeeper's roster card and Circle page, then reload.
expected: One consistent maximum on every desk, live and after a reload, never a pool above its maximum. Either the dead still count until replaced, or the pools are lowered as a release lowers them (decision fix4 1), with a circle_update.
actual: Live, every desk still reads 'Stitch 4 · max 4' and 'Refills: To 4 each'. After a reload the Lightkeeper reads 'Stitch 4 · max 3', 'Refresh 4 · max 3', 'Stitch: 4 of 3 available.' and 'Refills: To 3 each'. Players still read 4 of 4 until they reload. When the replacement is approved the max goes back to 4.
related: decisions_fix5 3 / decisions_fix4 1 (1 + members, lowered on leaving)

title: A scar owed is forgotten by the server on a restart: the Lightkeeper's copy drops 'scar owed'
where: Lightkeeper's copy of a sheet, laptop; backend/vtt/serializers.py awaiting_scar (in memory only, line 16-17), scar_pending in get_char_dict
steps: Deal a member a fourth mark, and the player presses Decide later. Restart the backend (restart_api.sh). Reload the Lightkeeper's desk and open the sheet, and reload the player's desk.
expected: Per decisions_fix6 1 (restarts lose nothing a player can see): the Lightkeeper's copy still reads 'Incapacitated: scar owed' and the player's stamp still says a scar is owed.
actual: The Lightkeeper's copy and the player's stamp read only 'Incapacitated'. The player's banner 'A scar is waiting' survives (kept in the browser), so the two desks disagree. On another device or with cleared storage the owed scar is lost, and the Lightkeeper can Revive with the scar never recorded. Recording it after the restart still works.

title: FAQ says the Lightkeeper revives, but the player's own sheet has Revive too
where: Player desk, phone 390x844, trauma record; frontend/src/components/pc/InvestigatorDossier.jsx:1466-1473 (Revive shown when !readOnly); FAQ.md:137 and :147
steps: A member is incapacitated and records the scar. On the player's own phone press Revive beside the Incapacitated stamp.
expected: FAQ.md: 'After an incapacitation, a GM can revive the character (revive_character action, the Revive button on the Lightkeeper's copy of the sheet)'. Rulebook p. 14: back in play when the circle gets them somewhere safe, the table's call. Either the player's button is not there, or the FAQ says players may revive themselves (detection, not prevention, decision fix5 1).
actual: The player revives themselves in one press, and the log line 'Bram Holt has been revived and is operational.' looks the same as the Lightkeeper's, so the Lightkeeper cannot tell who did it. The doc and the code disagree.

title: Scar form action choices are 28px tall on a phone

where: Player Circle page, Circle relationships, tablet 820x1180 touch

expected: Wording that matches the sheet and FAQ (the overfilled track is cleared and a scar is owed), as the scar form itself says.

title: Dead cannot file a report (on screen and crafted): not fixed
head: Not refused. On the tablet the dead investigator's Circle page keeps the report form with Send report live. It was sent and the server stored it ('Iris Vane filed an assignment report.' to every desk). A crafted submit_assignment_report with replace:true was taken too ('amended their assignment report'). title: Resources 1 + members around the death and the replacement: partly
head: After the replacement the max is 4 (1 + 3) on every desk live, current 4/4/3, nothing refilled after the seal (matches FAQ). Between the death and the replacement the max fell to 3 server side, with no desk told and the current left above it (see findings).

title: A scar owed across a server restart: partly
head: Bram was at scar owed (Decide later) when I restarted the backend. After the reloads the Lightkeeper's copy and the phone's stamp read only 'Incapacitated'. The phone's banner still said 'A scar is waiting' and Record the scar still worked (scars 2 of 4, shift applied). scar_pending is lost on the server (see findings).

title: After a restart, a refused gilded keep still shows an outcome and offers Burn
where: Player desk tray, 1920x1080 (any size); frontend store roll_result or resolve_gilded handling (gameStore.js action_rejected path near line 1170 sets pendingGildedChoice null but leaves the local kept result)
steps: Rhea rolls Strike gilded (2 dice) and leaves the choice waiting. Restart the API (restart_api.sh main 8190) and let the desk reconnect. Press Enter on 'Keep the gilded die'.
expected: Per rolls.py and WEBSOCKET.md the choice is refused and the player rolls again. The tray should say so and show no outcome and no burn, since nothing counted.
actual: The refusal line 'No roll is waiting for a die to be kept. Roll again.' shows under a result slip reading 'Strike: 2 dice, 1 gilded, kept the gilded 4 / MIXED SUCCESS'. 'AFTER THE ROLL: BURN AND REROLL' is offered too, which the server would also refuse. Nothing was logged at the table.

title: Non-Combatant drive point card is not sent again after a reload
where: Ally desk, phone 390x844; backend vtt/ws/handlers/marks.py send_open_intercepts (only Behind Me and Premonitions are re-sent; _non_combatant points are not)
steps: Finn (Doctor, Non-Combatant) takes a Body mark. Dax gets a Non-Combatant card (front) and a Behind Me card (queued). Reload Dax's desk 8 s later, inside the 2-minute window.
expected: Like Behind Me and Premonitions (FAQ: an offer comes back with the time left if the ally's page reloads; QUIRKS ally-offer-cards-lost-or-stale), the Non-Combatant card comes back. The server still holds Dax's point for the rest of the window.
actual: Only ability_intercept_offer Behind Me (expires_in 116) was sent again. The Non-Combatant card is gone, and the player cannot claim a point the server would still give. Later its lapse line appears in their log.

title: Non-Combatant card outlives a restart and its refusal is silent
where: Ally desk, phone 390x844 and tablet; gameStore.js withoutIntercepts drops only intercept offers on socket open; the action_rejected path sets abilityMarkRefused only for own-mark answers
steps: Finn takes a mark, so Dax and Esme get a Non-Combatant card. Restart the API and let the desks reconnect. The card is still up with its countdown (1:24 left). Pick NER and press Use.
expected: Decision fix6 #1 and FAQ: ally offers (Non-Combatant included) expire after a restart 'with the existing refusal', so the card closes on reconnect like Behind Me and Premonitions. Failing that, the refusal is shown, as 'PREMONITIONS NOT USED' is.
actual: Server sends action_rejected 'No Non-Combatant drive point is waiting.' The card just closes with no word on the desk, and no drive point comes. Behind Me and Premonitions cards on the same desk were closed at reconnect, so the two kinds of ally offer behave differently. In normal play, too, a lapsed Non-Combatant answer's refusal is replaced by the next card and never shown.

title: Live desk offers Burn and reroll after a restart; the refusal wording misleads
where: Player tray, laptop 1366x768; rolls.py _shown_roll is in memory, and the desk keeps lastRoll over a reconnect
steps: Finn rolls Control (Burn and reroll shown). Restart the API and let the desk reconnect without a reload. Press BURN AND REROLL.
expected: FAQ line 78: after a server restart the tray starts empty, since the server would refuse a burn. At least the burn should not be offered, or the refusal should say the roll was lost to a restart.
actual: Burn and reroll stays on offer after the reconnect. Pressed, it is refused with 'Burn a resistance after a roll of that action.', which is wrong in this case: Finn did roll that action. The tray then shows 'Roll settled'. After a reload the tray is empty, as documented.

title: Non-Combatant logs 'recovered 1' for a drive that was already full
where: backend vtt/ws/handlers/marks.py handle_resolve_ability_mark, Non-Combatant branch (lines 700-705)
steps: Esme has Intuition 3 of 3. Finn takes a mark and Esme is offered a Non-Combatant point. Pick INT and press Use.
expected: Like Well-Read (FAQ: the log names only what came back, and nothing when the drive was full): no line, or a line saying nothing came back. The card could also mark full drives.
actual: Intuition stays 3 (capped), yet every desk logs 'Esme Rook recovered 1 Intuition (Non-Combatant).' The point is used up. Here the answer was given to a card whose own window had lapsed, and the server credited it against the other point still waiting.

title: Behind Me and Premonitions cards do not say which mark
where: components/pc/AbilityMarkOffer.jsx ABILITY_OFFER_CONFIG descriptions; phone and tablet
steps: Finn takes a Body mark, then a Brain mark. Dax gets two Behind Me cards in turn.
expected: The card names the track, as the log does ('Dax Moor is offered Behind Me for Finn Ash's Brain mark').
actual: Both cards read 'Take Finn Ash's mark instead (spend 1 Nerve).' (Premonitions: 'Soak Finn Ash's mark ...'). The ally cannot tell which mark they are answering.

steps: Read section 7 and R7, then restart the API with desks open.
expected: The doc matches the code: gameStore.js reconnects with backoff 1, 2, 4, 8, 15 s and a heartbeat ping.
actual: The doc says 'There is no onclose handler and no reconnect ... a page reload fixes it' and 'the frontend does not reconnect'. In this check every desk reconnected by itself within 16 s.

title: 3.3 Ally offers expire after the restart: partly
head: Behind Me and Premonitions cards were dropped from the desk on reconnect (store withoutIntercepts on socket open) and not sent again, so they expired cleanly. A Behind Me answer was never possible after the restart. The Non-Combatant card instead stayed up with its countdown, and Use was refused with no word on the desk (see findings). No drive point or mark landed.

title: 3.4 Open roll with Burn and reroll across the restart: partly
head: Finn (laptop) Control roll, BURN AND REROLL shown. After the live reconnect the tray still offered Burn. Pressed, it was refused 'Burn a resistance after a roll of that action.' and the tray then read 'Roll settled'. Nothing was spent. After a reload the tray was empty, as FAQ says. The live desk offering a burn the server refuses is reported as a finding.

title: 3.5 Gilded die waiting for its choice across the restart: not fixed
head: Rhea Strike, 2 dice gilded, waiting. After the reconnect, Enter on 'Keep the gilded' was refused 'No roll is waiting for a die to be kept. Roll again.' (in memory only by design). But the slip then showed 'kept the gilded 4, MIXED SUCCESS' with a BURN AND REROLL button (finding).
